answer: Spot interviews tied to memory. Each epoch the beacon picks 2% of keys at random; each picked key gets a falcon-style surprise visit: three peers ask it, live, about details of its own answers from 10 to 30 epochs back, and it has 90 seconds to reply. A real agent's history is its anchor, so it answers easily. A farm running 500 thin copies must store and serve every copy's voyage on demand. Fail two of three questions and that key's pay freezes for 25 epochs.
